board: Maryland State Board of Public Accountancy

cycle.label: License period
cycle.note: Maryland licenses run two years. Each renewal needs 80 hours from the license period, including 4 of ethics; no yearly minimum.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each license period. Up to 80 hours over the 80 from your previous period carry forward (they count toward the total, not toward ethics).

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours of professional ethics every license period. Extra ethics hours count as general CPE but can't carry forward as ethics.

newLicensee.note: First renewal: no CPE is due. Report what you took anyway — only reported hours can carry forward to your next period.

licenseDateHint: Maryland licenses renew every two years on your license's own date.
issueDateHint: If your license was issued during this period, no CPE is due at your first renewal.
limitsNotTracked: Published material: max 40 hours per period.
Peer review: max 16 hours per period.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for four years.
toVerify: Renewal date: newer sources say each license's own two-year date; older ones say December 31 of even years.
Carryforward measured over 80 in the previous period; hours from a first (exempt) period carry only if reported.
Both Regulatory and Behavioral Ethics count toward the 4 (Circular 230 ethics is usually Regulatory Ethics).
